text:
Elena: Quick sync — 'Sightline' observability sprint. Need to lock scope for dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. ACME asked for per-tenant cost by model + regression alerts. Can we target M52?
Ravi: We can try. Biggest risk is tracing hook perf and tagging. Need sampling + lightweight span tags.
Jo: +1. Suggest minimal tracing surface: 3 span tags (model, route, tenant_id), linkouts to Jaeger, and timeline events in dashboard. Defer full trace UI.
Lena: For cost: we can ship an approximate per-route token cost by joining usage logs with model-cost table. Accurate per-tenant chargeback will take another week for reconciliation.
Elena: Proposed launch criteria: 1) dashboards with top-level cost + error KPIs, 2) tracing hooks instrumented in runtime with <1ms median overhead and p95 <5ms, 3) regression alerting wired to eval prompt sets. Anything missing?
Ravi: One implementation note: runtime change is small — set span tags at request start/end. Example:
```
span = tracer.start_span('inference')
span.set_tag('model', model_name)
span.set_tag('route', route)
span.set_tag('tenant_id', tenant_id)
span.finish()
```
Also add opt-in header `X-RW-OBS-SAMPLE: 1` for forced sampling.
Jo: Ops concern: need perf gating in CI so we don't regress latency. Plan: add `obs.perf` metric in staging, deploy-bot run canary, and block if p95 increases >10%.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for staging once PR lands. :robot_face:
Lena: Data notes: default retention 30d for dashboards. Per-tenant breakdown requires adding tenant_id to logs and aggregation keys. We'll need a short migration to backfill last 7 days.
Elena: Prioritization call: Must-have = dashboards (cost + error), tracing hooks (minimal tags + Jaeger links), basic alerting on eval regressions. Nice-to-have = exact per-tenant chargeback, full trace-store UI, heatmaps. If constrained, cut accurate chargeback and full UI.
Ravi: Rough capacity estimate: hooks (2 dev-days), dashboard widgets (3 dev-days), cost pipeline (3 dev-days), alerts (1 dev-day), QA/integration (2 dev-days) => ~11 dev-days but parallelizable. Feels doable for M52 if we coordinate.
Jo: I'll own perf gate. Will add a CI job that runs a 1k-request p95 baseline and fail if +10%.
Lena: I'll prototype cost join in sandbox and confirm backfill effort by Thursday.
Elena: Action items: Ravi -> prototype PR for hooks by EOD Wed; Lena -> sandbox cost prototype; Jo -> perf gate plan; Elena -> consolidate launch criteria doc + notify stakeholders. @Ravi @Lena @Jo
Ravi: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
Jo: Yup.
Lena: On it.
Elena: Thanks team — will follow up with a short doc and a checklist. :white_check_mark:
